df = pd.read_csv("/tmp/moutai_qfq.csv", parse_dates=["日期"])
df = df.sort_values("日期").reset_index(drop=True)
df.columns = ["date","code","open","close","high","low","volume","amount","amplitude","pct_chg","chg","turnover"]

o = df["open"]; c = df["close"]; h = df["high"]; l = df["low"]

first_close = c.iloc[0]
last_close = c.iloc[-1]
total_ret = (last_close / first_close - 1) * 100
period_high = h.max(); period_high_date = df.loc[h.idxmax(), "date"].date()
period_low  = l.min(); period_low_date  = df.loc[l.idxmin(), "date"].date()

# 最大回撤

drawdown = (c / cummax - 1) * 100
max_dd = drawdown.min()
max_dd_end = df.loc[drawdown.idxmin(), "date"].date()

# 均线
for w in [5,10,20,60,120]:

# 区间收益率分段
def seg_ret(a, b):
